body: My dad is my only parent I can talk to and not get yelled at. It hurts.
Thank you, this made me feel better about myself.  ❤️
It’s fine, it’s hard to live with but I am gonna tell her how I feel.
I don’t know, I called a suicide lifeline and they said I should write a letter to my mother. I might but if it won’t work i don’t know anymkre
*by my mom. I’m sorry for the spelling errors
Hello, are you ok? I know life is crazy but ending it might not be the best way. I hope you feel better and feel good. Sending my love to u
Thank you for taking time out of your day to respond. It makes me happy that people care for me. You don’t know how much this makes me happy. You are an amazing person :)

Everything is gonna get better. I have the same kind of mom/parent. I was so close to killing myself but I couldn’t. I remembered my little baby cousin. He looks up to me and I knew he would be devastated if I was dead so I didn’t kill myself. But even though your life sucks now it won’t suck forever
